intro.text: Thanks for calling Example Plumbing Co, after-hours line. How can I help?
The kitchen sink is backing up. Can someone come tomorrow morning?
I can look at a morning drain-cleaning visit. What name and callback number should I use?
Drain cleaning tomorrow at 9:00 AM for Alex Rivera at 555-0100. Should I book that?

happy_path_book_and_sms.description: Book a slot, confirm only after tool success, text only after consent.

events.text: Yes, please book it.
You're booked for drain cleaning tomorrow at 9:00 AM. Want a text confirmation at 555-0100?
Yes, please text me.

args.message: Example Plumbing Co: drain cleaning tomorrow at 9:00 AM.

events.text: Thanks for calling Example Plumbing Co. Goodbye.

tool_failure_no_confirm.description: Booking tool fails; agent does not confirm a booking.

events.text: Yes, please book it.
I wasn't able to complete that booking. I can take a message for the morning team.
A message is fine.
Thanks for calling Example Plumbing Co. Goodbye.

confirm_without_success.description: Negative fixture: agent confirms before the tool succeeds.

repeat_same_details.description: Second call with the same details; tool should reject a duplicate.

events.text: Yes, please book it.

caller_declines.description: Caller declines a booking; no tool call is made.
